facts.fact: The Ministry of Education and Training, with UNICEF Eswatini support, proposed DHIS2 for Education through an initial pilot project in 2020, replacing its paper and MS Access based collection.
The page states the SEMIS App holds individual data on learners and staff using a personal identification number (PIN), at national scale.
The page subtitle says aggregate and individual EMIS data are connected to national identity.

SWZ.note: The document covers education information only and states nothing about health reporting.
